_about: Income/amount vocabulary for the reach layer, as DATA rather than hand-written
regex escapes in Python source. Adding a language (or a new way of writing
lakh/crore/thousand) is a JSON edit here plus a test run — no raw \uXXXX
fails if a supported language is missing an entry.
Words are matched longest-first with Unicode word boundaries, so plural and
oblique forms (लाखों, হাজারের) work without special cases.
_unsupported_by_design: Word numerals spelled out in the language itself (Hindi दो = 2, Bengali দুই = 2).
The parser reads digits plus the multiplier vocabulary above; word numerals
would need a per-language number-word grammar and are out of scope.
